RagShortTexts: Genoese crossbowmen deployed massive pavises to shield reloading arbalests in lethal volleys.

Variants.Content: The Genoese crossbowmen constitute Europe's premier ranged mercenary corps. Operating in coordinated pairs, one specialist plants a man-tall curved pavise shield into the soil, while the arbalester spans heavy composite cross-bows with foot stirrups, discharging armor-piercing iron bolts.
Behind a locked line of pavises, we can break any cavalry charge at eighty paces. Keep your cord dry in the rain, and never let light horsemen get behind your shield-bearer while spanning.

Contracting five hundred Genoese crossbowmen demands heavy chests of Genoese florins, but whether assaulting an Andalusian breach or garrisoning Acre, their disciplined volleys deliver unmatched suppression.
